core_categories: E-Pharmacy; E-Diagnostics; Tele-Consultation; Health Products; Medical Information
specialty_focus: Tata 1mg is a digital consumer healthcare platform in India, operating as an e-pharmacy and e-diagnostics provider with tele-consultation services. It distributes medicines, wellness products, and diagnostic services through a network of licensed regional medical distributors and over 600 local health partners across 1,800+ Indian cities. It does not specifically focus on wearable medical devices, though it offers some health products like heating belts.
key_brands: Mankind Pharma, Piramal Consumer Health, Reckitt Benckiser, Dr. Morepen, Cipla, MuscleBlaze, Exagon Nutrition, others
